action: proud winner: the eagle puffs out its chest with a big happy smile and bright open eyes, lifts a shiny golden trophy cup high above its head with one wing and holds it perfectly still, the gold shines with twinkling sparkles and a white glint, a warm golden glowing aura shines around the whole eagle and pulses brighter while it holds the trophy, soft golden light and glowing sparkles radiating from its body, then lowers the trophy, the glow fades and it settles back happy; the branch never moves, feet stay gripping the branch, eyes stay open and happy the whole time
